findings.query: MENA cloud POS market growth forecast 2025
findings.finding: The global cloud POS market was valued at USD 6.51 billion in 2025 and is expected to rise to USD 7.72 billion in 2026. Overall POS market size was USD 28.9 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach USD 111 billion by 2035. In 2025, software accounted for 59.40% of the cloud POS market share, while services are forecast to grow at a 20.95% CAGR. The Middle East and Africa region represented 7% of the market in 2025 and is expected to expand at an 8.08% CAGR through 2035, with the broader MENA POS market projected to grow at a 16.8% CAGR.

findings.query: Egypt Ministry of Communications and Information Technology digital payment licensing requirements for POS providers
findings.finding: Egypt’s central bank requires payment system operators to obtain a licence and pay a fee of 70,000 EGP for account‑information service providers, and to submit all required documents (source [1]). The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) is actively promoting digital payments, exemplified by Egypt Post’s relaunch of Easy Pay and government‑backed subsidies for POS terminals and mobile‑payment acceptance (sources [2],[3]). Open‑banking rules and e‑invoicing frameworks are also being formalised under MCIT and ITIDA, indicating a tightening regulatory environment for fintech and POS providers (sources [4],[6]).
